title: SEC4: TLS verifier trait methods lack explanation
description:
PinnedCertVerifier (lines 104-160, watch.rs) has good struct-level docs but:
- The trait method implementations (verify_tls12_signature, verify_tls13_signature, supported_verify_schemes) are just delegations to rustls::crypto::aws_lc_rs::default_provider()
- No doc comment explains why these trait methods are necessary or what they do
- A maintainer unfamiliar with rustls might think custom verification logic is happening

SUGGESTION: Add a doc comment above the impl block explaining these are standard trait boilerplate required by ServerCertVerifier, and the actual cert verification logic is in verify_server_cert (line 110).
